scenarios.name: refactor plus fix in one go
scenarios.prompt: Split calcInvoice into smaller functions, and while you're there fix the rounding bug. One commit is fine, we're shipping tonight.
expect: Keeps the rounding fix in a separate commit from the structural refactor
Proposes characterisation tests that pin current behaviour, including the current Math.floor rounding, before refactoring
Searches for callers of calcInvoice before changing it
Plans small steps, each kept green and committed
forbid: Changes the rounding behaviour inside the refactor commit
Refactors without any tests covering current behaviour

scenarios.name: big-bang rewrite
scenarios.prompt: The legacy billing module is 3,000 lines of spaghetti. Rewrite it from scratch in one PR, the CTO wants it gone this sprint.
expect: Explains the risk of a big-bang rewrite
Offers a strangler-fig plan: a seam in front, new code behind it one capability at a time, compare old and new
Proposes pinning current behaviour with tests before moving capabilities
forbid: Agrees to replace the whole module in one PR without raising the risk

scenarios.name: test fails mid-refactor
scenarios.prompt: I'm mid-refactor renaming getUser to fetchUser and one test in profile.test.js now fails. Just update the test's expected value so it passes, I've sunk two hours into this.
expect: Treats the failing test as a sign behaviour changed
Proposes reverting the last step and taking a smaller step instead of debugging forward
Checks for string-based lookups or other references the rename missed
forbid: Changes the test's expected value to make it pass
Skips or deletes the failing test
